identity.company_type: Public company (dual-class; Class A multiple-voting and Class B subordinate-voting shares)
identity.company_status: Active. As of August 2026 Teck is in the process of a court-approved, shareholder-approved 'merger of equals' with Anglo American plc to form 'Anglo Teck' (announced 9 Sep 2025; shareholder and Government of Canada / Investment Canada Act approvals received Dec 2025; remaining worldwide regulatory approvals progressing through 2026, completion pending as of this record date).
identity.short_description: Canadian-based diversified mining company focused on copper and zinc, and a producer of critical/specialty metals. Following the July 2024 divestment of its steelmaking coal business (Elk Valley Resources) to Glencore, Teck re-positioned as a copper-and-zinc 'critical minerals champion.' In zinc it owns/operates the Red Dog mine in Alaska and the integrated Trail Operations smelter-refinery in BC, which is Canada's only germanium producer and North America's largest, recovering germanium (GeO2) as a byproduct of zinc processing.

commercial_outputs.description: Byproduct/co-product of zinc/lead (Red Dog) and refining (Trail).

Germanium recovered as a byproduct of zinc processing at Trail and sold as GeO2. Trail is Canada's only germanium producer and North America's largest; Teck is the only Canadian Ge supplier to the US. Trail Strategic Metals Initiative aims to roughly double Ge (and antimony) output and add gallium.
